matchs has NO primary key (pk=[]); sample_fresh_primary_keys must no-op on empty PK, and drop_unique_duplicates has no unique columns to act on.
matchs.Div is a FK to divisions.division but has distinct=22 > parent distinct=21: at least one child value has no parent (dangling FK in original data).
divisions.division is TEXT PK with values like 'B1','D1','E0' — short codes, not numeric; String fuzzer will not reproduce them from scratch.
matchs.Date declared DATE but stored as TEXT 'YYYY-MM-DD'; first element parses as int? no -> Date fuzzer with template %Y-%m-%d (text storage).
matchs.season INTEGER but semantically a year (2017..2021); declared type dispatches to Number, not Year fuzzer.
FTHG/FTAG INTEGER with only 11 distinct values (0..~10 goals); Number fuzzer range [-10^scale,10^scale] with scale from no args -> wide, implausible.
FTR TEXT with 3 distinct values 'A','D','H' (result codes); String fuzzer will emit random strings, not these codes.
divisions.country has 11 distinct for 21 rows (many-to-one); name 21 distinct.
matchs is 123k rows, well under max_rows_per_table=300000; full read fine, no rowid sampling needed.
No composite keys, no self-references, no views/triggers/indexes beyond PK; DDL is plain.
FK parent divisions.division is unique (PK) so FK fill is well-defined; child Div null_rate 0 but column nullable.

matchs.Div: FK fill draws from divisions.division final values with replacement -> consistent but random codes; joins still work, so FK-join queries survive.
matchs.Date: Date fuzzer, template %Y-%m-%d, range from min/max parsed dates (~2020) -> plausible dates; date-range predicates likely preserved (low FN).
matchs.season: Number fuzzer, no args -> scale 0, range [-1,1] roughly, then +-1/+-2 perturbation -> values like -1,0,1,2, NOT 2017-2021; season filters (season=2020) will return empty -> FN.
FTHG/FTAG: Number fuzzer scale 0 -> small ints around 0 with perturbation; plausibly 0-3, may match goal-count predicates by luck; aggregates (avg goals) distorted.

divisions.name/country: random strings; country='England' predicates empty -> FN.
No PK on matchs -> no dedup, so duplicate rows possible; COUNT(*) queries on matchs get arbitrary size from choose_table_sizes (30..2500 or level-based), not 123k -> count predicates FN.
FK consistency preserved (Div in divisions) so join-cardinality queries roughly shaped; but divisions only ~21 rows so matchs/divisions join fan-out differs from original.
